report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 71ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR span (gateway call order, 989ms) exists, and no order-side telemetry was collected. Evidence is insufficient to establish any bounded root-cause candidate; hand off for downstream evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/metrics/logs for the same window to confirm or refute downstream latency or errors
Gateway error-rate and p95 time series over a longer window to confirm the alert vs. the 0.0014 error rate and 71ms p95 observed
Dependency timeout and db_pool_waiter metrics for order, payment, inventory, and postgresql
Logs from order/payment/inventory showing error or timeout events during the window
